title: Sheet-metal cost as a derivative of the model
summary: Live, line-itemed manufacturing cost for sheet-metal parts — material/cut/pierce/bend/setup with shop markup, in the panel and as an MCP tool. No more send-to-shop-wait-three-days for a quote.
details:
## What's New

- **Cost badge** in the sheet-metal panel: per-unit total + expandable breakdown (material kg, cut length, pierces, bends, setup, markup) that recomputes live on every edit. Editable quantity for setup amortization.
- **`sheet_metal_cost` MCP tool**: agents see which line dominates and which design changes lower the price.
- Kernel `vcad-kernel-sheet::cost`: pure function of `(model, flat, qty, rates)`. Mass comes from the flat area × thickness × material density (lookups via the materials registry, so swapping alloy updates cost). Generic low-volume laser-cut defaults work out of the box; rates are field-tolerant for shop overrides.
